# 1. Setup

```{r load-libraries}
library(UpSetR)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)  # alternative UpSet engine (more robust)
library(grid)

cat("Libraries loaded.\n")
```


# 2. Load DEG Data

```{r load-data}
timepoints <- c("24h", "48h", "96h")

safe_load <- function(f) {
  if (file.exists(f)) {
    df <- read.csv(f, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, row.names = 1)
    if (nrow(df) > 0) return(df)
  }
  return(NULL)
}

# Load all DEG files
ha_degs <- setNames(lapply(timepoints, function(tp)
  safe_load(sprintf("Ha_pathogen_aggressive_vs_low_DEGs_%s.csv", tp))), timepoints)

gm_degs <- setNames(lapply(timepoints, function(tp)
  safe_load(sprintf("Gm_pathogen_aggressive_vs_low_DEGs_%s.csv", tp))), timepoints)

# Build gene sets (character vectors of gene IDs)
ha_sets <- lapply(ha_degs, function(df) if (!is.null(df)) rownames(df) else character(0))
gm_sets <- lapply(gm_degs, function(df) if (!is.null(df)) rownames(df) else character(0))

# Which timepoints have data?
ha_avail <- timepoints[sapply(ha_sets, function(x) length(x) > 0)]
gm_avail <- timepoints[sapply(gm_sets, function(x) length(x) > 0)]

cat("Ha timepoints with data:", paste(ha_avail, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("Gm timepoints with data:", paste(gm_avail, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Combine into one named list
all_sets <- list()
for (tp in ha_avail) all_sets[[paste0("Ha_", tp)]] <- ha_sets[[tp]]
for (tp in gm_avail) all_sets[[paste0("Gm_", tp)]] <- gm_sets[[tp]]

cat("\nSets for UpSet plot:\n")
for (nm in names(all_sets)) cat(sprintf("  %s: %d genes\n", nm, length(all_sets[[nm]])))
```

# 3. Build Binary Membership Matrix

```{r build-matrix}
# Create the binary matrix that both UpSetR and ComplexHeatmap need
all_genes <- unique(unlist(all_sets))
cat(sprintf("Total unique genes: %d\n", length(all_genes)))

mat <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(all_genes), ncol = length(all_sets),
              dimnames = list(all_genes, names(all_sets)))

for (nm in names(all_sets)) {
  mat[all_sets[[nm]], nm] <- 1L
}

# Convert to data.frame for UpSetR
upset_df <- as.data.frame(mat)

# Print intersection summary
patterns <- apply(mat, 1, function(row) paste(names(all_sets)[row == 1], collapse = " + "))
pattern_tab <- sort(table(patterns), decreasing = TRUE)

cat("\n=== TOP 15 INTERSECTION PATTERNS ===\n")
print(head(pattern_tab, 15))
```

# 4. UpSet Plot — UpSetR Package (Simple & Clean)

```{r upset-basic, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# ===================================================================
# Basic UpSetR plot — no queries (avoids the intersects() crash)
# Color set bars by host: orange = Sunflower, blue = Soybean
# ===================================================================

set_order <- rev(names(all_sets))
bar_colors <- ifelse(grepl("^Ha_", set_order), "#E69F00", "#56B4E9")

upset(upset_df,
      sets = set_order,
      keep.order = TRUE,
      order.by = "freq",
      nsets = length(all_sets),
      nintersects = 30,
      mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4),
      point.size = 4,
      line.size = 1.5,
      sets.bar.color = bar_colors,
      main.bar.color = "gray30",
      mainbar.y.label = "Intersection Size\n(Number of Pathogen DEGs)",
      sets.x.label = "DEGs per Condition",
      text.scale = c(1.6, 1.3, 1.2, 1.2, 1.6, 1.3),
      set_size.show = TRUE,
      set_size.scale_max = max(sapply(all_sets, length)) * 1.2)
```

## 4.1 With Metadata Bar Chart (by regulation direction)

```{r upset-metadata, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# ===================================================================
# UpSetR with metadata: show Up/Down regulation breakdown per bar
# ===================================================================

# Build direction column: for each gene, classify as Up, Down, or Mixed
# based on its log2FC across all conditions where it's significant
lfc_col <- "log2FoldChange"

gene_direction <- sapply(all_genes, function(g) {
  lfcs <- c()
  for (tp in ha_avail) {
    df <- ha_degs[[tp]]
    if (!is.null(df) && g %in% rownames(df)) lfcs <- c(lfcs, df[g, lfc_col])
  }
  for (tp in gm_avail) {
    df <- gm_degs[[tp]]
    if (!is.null(df) && g %in% rownames(df)) lfcs <- c(lfcs, df[g, lfc_col])
  }
  if (length(lfcs) == 0) return("Unknown")
  if (all(lfcs > 0)) return("Up")
  if (all(lfcs < 0)) return("Down")
  return("Mixed")
})

upset_df_meta <- upset_df
upset_df_meta$Direction <- gene_direction

upset(upset_df_meta,
      sets = set_order,
      keep.order = TRUE,
      order.by = "freq",
      nsets = length(all_sets),
      nintersects = 30,
      mb.ratio = c(0.55, 0.45),
      point.size = 4,
      line.size = 1.5,
      sets.bar.color = bar_colors,
      mainbar.y.label = "Intersection Size",
      sets.x.label = "DEGs per Condition",
      text.scale = c(1.6, 1.3, 1.2, 1.2, 1.6, 1.3),
      set_size.show = TRUE,
      queries = list(
        list(query = elements, params = list("Direction", "Up"),
             color = "#D73027", active = TRUE, query.name = "Up-regulated"),
        list(query = elements, params = list("Direction", "Down"),
             color = "#4575B4", active = TRUE, query.name = "Down-regulated"),
        list(query = elements, params = list("Direction", "Mixed"),
             color = "#FDB863", active = TRUE, query.name = "Mixed")
      ),
      query.legend = "top")
```

# 5. UpSet Plot — ComplexHeatmap (Recommended)

```{r complex-upset, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# ===================================================================
# ComplexHeatmap::UpSet is more powerful and does NOT have the
# intersects() crash bug. It also supports better annotations.
# ===================================================================

# Create combination matrix
comb_mat <- make_comb_mat(mat, mode = "distinct")

# Filter: only show intersections with >= 2 genes (remove singletons)
comb_mat <- comb_mat[comb_size(comb_mat) >= 2]

# Sort by frequency
comb_mat <- comb_mat[order(comb_size(comb_mat), decreasing = TRUE)]

# Define set colors
set_cols <- ifelse(grepl("^Ha_", set_name(comb_mat)), "#E69F00", "#56B4E9")

# Identify cross-host intersections for bar coloring
comb_names <- comb_name(comb_mat)
bar_col <- rep("gray30", length(comb_names))

# Color bars involving both hosts
for (i in seq_along(comb_names)) {
  members <- set_name(comb_mat)[as.logical(as.integer(strsplit(comb_names[i], "")[[1]]))]
  has_ha <- any(grepl("^Ha_", members))
  has_gm <- any(grepl("^Gm_", members))
  if (has_ha && has_gm) {
    bar_col[i] <- "#DC143C"  # red for cross-host
  } else if (has_ha) {
    bar_col[i] <- "#E69F00"  # orange for Ha-only
  } else if (has_gm) {
    bar_col[i] <- "#56B4E9"  # blue for Gm-only
  }
}

# Draw UpSet
ht <- UpSet(comb_mat,
      set_order = rev(set_name(comb_mat)),
      comb_order = order(comb_size(comb_mat), decreasing = TRUE),
      
      # Top bar (intersection sizes)
      top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
        "Intersection\nSize" = anno_barplot(
          comb_size(comb_mat),
          gp = gpar(fill = bar_col, col = bar_col),
          border = FALSE,
          height = unit(8, "cm"),
          add_numbers = TRUE,
          numbers_gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)
        ),
        annotation_name_side = "left",
        annotation_name_rot = 0
      ),
      
      # Left bar (set sizes)
      left_annotation = rowAnnotation(
        "Set Size" = anno_barplot(
          set_size(comb_mat),
          gp = gpar(fill = set_cols),
          border = FALSE,
          width = unit(4, "cm"),
          add_numbers = TRUE,
          numbers_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
        ),
        annotation_name_rot = 0
      ),
      
      # Matrix dots
      pt_size = unit(4, "mm"),
      lwd = 2,
      
      # Row/column labels
      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold",
                           col = set_cols),
      
      # Column title
      column_title = "Sclerotinia Pathogen DEGs: Cross-Host UpSet Plot",
      column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 16, fontface = "bold")
)

draw(ht)

# Legend
grid.text("Orange = Sunflower (Ha)  |  Blue = Soybean (Gm)  |  Red = Cross-host",
          x = 0.5, y = 0.01, gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, col = "gray40"))
```

## 5.1 ComplexHeatmap UpSet with Direction Annotation

```{r complex-upset-annotated, fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
# ===================================================================
# Enhanced version: add a stacked bar showing Up/Down/Mixed per intersection
# ===================================================================

# Recalculate direction counts per intersection
comb_mat2 <- make_comb_mat(mat, mode = "distinct")
comb_mat2 <- comb_mat2[comb_size(comb_mat2) >= 2]
comb_mat2 <- comb_mat2[order(comb_size(comb_mat2), decreasing = TRUE)]

# For each intersection, count Up/Down/Mixed genes
comb_ids <- comb_name(comb_mat2)
dir_counts <- data.frame(Up = integer(length(comb_ids)),
                          Down = integer(length(comb_ids)),
                          Mixed = integer(length(comb_ids)))

for (i in seq_along(comb_ids)) {
  genes_in_comb <- extract_comb(comb_mat2, comb_ids[i])
  dirs <- gene_direction[genes_in_comb]
  dir_counts$Up[i]    <- sum(dirs == "Up", na.rm = TRUE)
  dir_counts$Down[i]  <- sum(dirs == "Down", na.rm = TRUE)
  dir_counts$Mixed[i] <- sum(dirs == "Mixed", na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Set colors
set_cols2 <- ifelse(grepl("^Ha_", set_name(comb_mat2)), "#E69F00", "#56B4E9")

# Bar colors for intersections
bar_col2 <- rep("gray30", length(comb_ids))
for (i in seq_along(comb_ids)) {
  members <- set_name(comb_mat2)[as.logical(as.integer(strsplit(comb_ids[i], "")[[1]]))]
  has_ha <- any(grepl("^Ha_", members))
  has_gm <- any(grepl("^Gm_", members))
  if (has_ha && has_gm) bar_col2[i] <- "#DC143C"
  else if (has_ha) bar_col2[i] <- "#E69F00"
  else if (has_gm) bar_col2[i] <- "#56B4E9"
}

ht2 <- UpSet(comb_mat2,
      set_order = rev(set_name(comb_mat2)),
      comb_order = order(comb_size(comb_mat2), decreasing = TRUE),
      
      top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
        # Main bar: intersection size
        "Intersection\nSize" = anno_barplot(
          comb_size(comb_mat2),
          gp = gpar(fill = bar_col2, col = bar_col2),
          border = FALSE,
          height = unit(6, "cm"),
          add_numbers = TRUE,
          numbers_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
        ),
        # Stacked bar: direction breakdown
        "Regulation" = anno_barplot(
          as.matrix(dir_counts),
          gp = gpar(fill = c("#D73027", "#4575B4", "#FDB863"),
                    col = c("#D73027", "#4575B4", "#FDB863")),
          border = FALSE,
          height = unit(4, "cm"),
          bar_width = 0.8
        ),
        annotation_name_side = "left",
        annotation_name_rot = 0,
        gap = unit(2, "mm")
      ),
      
      left_annotation = rowAnnotation(
        "Set Size" = anno_barplot(
          set_size(comb_mat2),
          gp = gpar(fill = set_cols2),
          border = FALSE,
          width = unit(4, "cm"),
          add_numbers = TRUE,
          numbers_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
        ),
        annotation_name_rot = 0
      ),
      
      pt_size = unit(4, "mm"),
      lwd = 2,
      row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold", col = set_cols2),
      column_title = "Pathogen DEGs: Intersection Size & Regulation Direction",
      column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold")
)

# Add legend
lgd <- Legend(
  labels = c("Up-regulated", "Down-regulated", "Mixed"),
  legend_gp = gpar(fill = c("#D73027", "#4575B4", "#FDB863")),
  title = "Regulation",
  title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold"),
  labels_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)
)

draw(ht2, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd))
```

# 6. UpSet — Focused on Cross-Host Comparison Only

```{r upset-cross-only, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
# ===================================================================
# Simplified 2-set view: combine all Ha timepoints vs all Gm timepoints
# Then break down by which timepoints each gene appears in
# ===================================================================

# 4-set version: Ha_early(24h), Ha_late(48+96h), Gm_early(24h), Gm_late(48+96h)
sets_grouped <- list()

if (length(ha_avail) > 0) {
  if ("24h" %in% ha_avail) sets_grouped[["Ha_early\n(24h)"]] <- ha_sets[["24h"]]
  late_ha <- unique(c(
    if ("48h" %in% ha_avail) ha_sets[["48h"]] else character(0),
    if ("96h" %in% ha_avail) ha_sets[["96h"]] else character(0)
  ))
  if (length(late_ha) > 0) sets_grouped[["Ha_late\n(48-96h)"]] <- late_ha
}

if (length(gm_avail) > 0) {
  if ("24h" %in% gm_avail) sets_grouped[["Gm_early\n(24h)"]] <- gm_sets[["24h"]]
  late_gm <- unique(c(
    if ("48h" %in% gm_avail) gm_sets[["48h"]] else character(0),
    if ("96h" %in% gm_avail) gm_sets[["96h"]] else character(0)
  ))
  if (length(late_gm) > 0) sets_grouped[["Gm_late\n(48-96h)"]] <- late_gm
}

if (length(sets_grouped) >= 2) {
  
  all_g2 <- unique(unlist(sets_grouped))
  mat2 <- matrix(0L, nrow = length(all_g2), ncol = length(sets_grouped),
                 dimnames = list(all_g2, names(sets_grouped)))
  for (nm in names(sets_grouped)) mat2[sets_grouped[[nm]], nm] <- 1L
  
  comb_mat3 <- make_comb_mat(mat2, mode = "distinct")
  comb_mat3 <- comb_mat3[comb_size(comb_mat3) >= 1]
  comb_mat3 <- comb_mat3[order(comb_size(comb_mat3), decreasing = TRUE)]
  
  set_cols3 <- ifelse(grepl("^Ha", set_name(comb_mat3)), "#E69F00", "#56B4E9")
  
  comb_ids3 <- comb_name(comb_mat3)
  bar_col3 <- rep("gray30", length(comb_ids3))
  for (i in seq_along(comb_ids3)) {
    members <- set_name(comb_mat3)[as.logical(as.integer(strsplit(comb_ids3[i], "")[[1]]))]
    has_ha <- any(grepl("^Ha", members))
    has_gm <- any(grepl("^Gm", members))
    if (has_ha && has_gm) bar_col3[i] <- "#DC143C"
    else if (has_ha) bar_col3[i] <- "#E69F00"
    else if (has_gm) bar_col3[i] <- "#56B4E9"
  }
  
  ht3 <- UpSet(comb_mat3,
        set_order = rev(set_name(comb_mat3)),
        comb_order = order(comb_size(comb_mat3), decreasing = TRUE),
        top_annotation = HeatmapAnnotation(
          "Intersection\nSize" = anno_barplot(
            comb_size(comb_mat3),
            gp = gpar(fill = bar_col3, col = bar_col3),
            border = FALSE, height = unit(7, "cm"),
            add_numbers = TRUE, numbers_gp = gpar(fontsize = 10)),
          annotation_name_side = "left", annotation_name_rot = 0),
        left_annotation = rowAnnotation(
          "Set Size" = anno_barplot(
            set_size(comb_mat3),
            gp = gpar(fill = set_cols3),
            border = FALSE, width = unit(4, "cm"),
            add_numbers = TRUE, numbers_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11)),
          annotation_name_rot = 0),
        pt_size = unit(5, "mm"), lwd = 2.5,
        row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 13, fontface = "bold", col = set_cols3),
        column_title = "Pathogen DEGs: Early vs Late × Sunflower vs Soybean",
        column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 15, fontface = "bold"))
  
  draw(ht3)
  grid.text("Orange = Sunflower  |  Blue = Soybean  |  Red = Cross-host",
            x = 0.5, y = 0.01, gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, col = "gray40"))
}
```

# 7. Save Plots as PDF

```{r save-pdfs, eval=FALSE}
# --- UpSetR version ---
pdf("Fig_UpSet_pathogen_DEGs_UpSetR.pdf", width = 14, height = 8)

      sets = set_order, keep.order = TRUE, order.by = "freq",
      nsets = length(all_sets), nintersects = 30,
      mb.ratio = c(0.6, 0.4), point.size = 4, line.size = 1.5,
      sets.bar.color = bar_colors, main.bar.color = "gray30",
      mainbar.y.label = "Intersection Size", sets.x.label = "DEGs per Condition",
      text.scale = c(1.6, 1.3, 1.2, 1.2, 1.6, 1.3), set_size.show = TRUE)

draw(ht)
grid.text("Orange = Sunflower (Ha)  |  Blue = Soybean (Gm)  |  Red = Cross-host",
          x = 0.5, y = 0.01, gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, col = "gray40"))
dev.off()
cat("Saved: Fig_UpSet_pathogen_DEGs_ComplexHeatmap.pdf\n")

# --- ComplexHeatmap with direction annotation ---

draw(ht2, annotation_legend_list = list(lgd))

# --- Early/Late grouped version ---

  pdf("Fig_UpSet_pathogen_DEGs_early_vs_late.pdf", width = 12, height = 7)
  draw(ht3)
  grid.text("Orange = Sunflower  |  Blue = Soybean  |  Red = Cross-host",
            x = 0.5, y = 0.01, gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, col = "gray40"))
  dev.off()
  cat("Saved: Fig_UpSet_pathogen_DEGs_early_vs_late.pdf\n")
}
```

# 8. Summary

```{r summary}
cat("\n=== UPSET PLOT SUMMARY ===\n\n")
cat(sprintf("Total unique pathogen DEGs: %d\n", length(all_genes)))
cat(sprintf("Sets: %d (%s)\n", length(all_sets), paste(names(all_sets), collapse=", ")))

cat("\nSet sizes:\n")
for (nm in names(all_sets)) cat(sprintf("  %s: %d\n", nm, length(all_sets[[nm]])))

cat("\nDirection breakdown:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Up-regulated:   %d (%.1f%%)\n", sum(gene_direction=="Up"),
            100*mean(gene_direction=="Up")))
cat(sprintf("  Down-regulated: %d (%.1f%%)\n", sum(gene_direction=="Down"),
            100*mean(gene_direction=="Down")))
cat(sprintf("  Mixed:          %d (%.1f%%)\n", sum(gene_direction=="Mixed"),
            100*mean(gene_direction=="Mixed")))

cat("\nCross-host overlap:\n")
ha_all <- unique(unlist(ha_sets))
gm_all <- unique(unlist(gm_sets))
cat(sprintf("  Ha total: %d  |  Gm total: %d  |  Shared: %d\n",
            length(ha_all), length(gm_all), length(intersect(ha_all, gm_all))))

for (tp in intersect(ha_avail, gm_avail)) {
  cat(sprintf("  Shared at %s: %d\n", tp, length(intersect(ha_sets[[tp]], gm_sets[[tp]]))))
}

cat("\nPlots generated:\n")
cat("  1. UpSetR basic (set bars colored by host)\n")
cat("  2. UpSetR with Up/Down/Mixed metadata\n")
cat("  3. ComplexHeatmap UpSet (cross-host bars in red)\n")
cat("  4. ComplexHeatmap UpSet + regulation stacked bars\n")
cat("  5. Grouped early/late × host comparison\n")
```
